name: unbound
description: Validating, recursive, and caching DNS resolver

fields.name: UNBOUND_DNS_TCP_MAPPING
fields.label: R1: DNS TCP Port Mapping
fields.help:
Publishes Unbound DNS over TCP on host port 5553 and container port 53.
The mapping is omitted automatically in host mode.

fields.name: UNBOUND_DNS_UDP_MAPPING
fields.label: R2: DNS UDP Port Mapping
fields.help:
Publishes Unbound DNS over UDP on host port 5553 and container port 53.
The mapping is omitted automatically in host mode.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O1: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: UNBOUND_NETWORK_MODE
fields.label: O2: Network
fields.help:
Choose Create New Bridge, Host Mode, or an existing Docker network such as dns-network.
Bridge or an existing network keeps host port 5553. Host mode removes port translation and Unbound listens directly on host port 53.

fields.name: UNBOUND_IMAGE
fields.label: A1: Image
fields.help:
Docker image used for Unbound.
Change this only if you want a different tag or image source.

fields.name: UNBOUND_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker sets the container name from the project name.

ui.overview: Unbound is a validating, recursive, and caching DNS resolver that can be used directly or as the upstream resolver for AdGuard Home.
what_happens: An Unbound container will be created using the klutchell/unbound image
DNS will be published over both TCP and UDP on host port 5553 in bridge or selected-network mode
You can create a new bridge, use host networking, or attach Unbound to an existing network such as dns-network
When AdGuard Home shares the same Docker network, configure its upstream DNS server as unbound:53
When AdGuard Home reaches Unbound through the Docker host, configure its upstream DNS server as the host address on port 5553
Host mode does not use port translation and therefore makes Unbound listen directly on host port 53
ui.data_location: The default image configuration is built into the container; this recipe does not create or mount persistent data folders.
